toc.title: Serenissimo potentissimoque principi, ac domino nostro, Iacobo, Dei gratia, Magnæ Britanniæ, Franciæ & Hiberniæ regi, fidei defensori &c.

Declaratio, atque confessio D. de Balmerinoch Regiæ Maiestati facta, ac Dominis qui ei à Sanctiore Consilio sunt, de literis quibusdam, quas ille, per fraudem surreptitiè scribendas Regio nomine, atque Romam, ad Papam Clementem 8um. quasi suâ Maiestate essent, mittendas curavit. Anno 1598.

book: A single Latin work, Lancelot Andrewes's 1609 response to Matthaeus Tortus (Tortura Torti), built as a dedication to James I, a prefatory letter, and then one continuous refutation of Tortus's book against the Apology for the Oath of Allegiance, with no printed chapter divisions and one quoted document under its own heading.
